description: This PHP class 'EmailImportService' provides a service for importing emails from inbound email accounts, handling various protocols, message retrieval, processing, and related operations within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for connecting to mail servers, importing messages, updating import times, and handling email-related data management.

classes.name: EmailImportService
classes.description: A service class for importing inbound emails, managing email retrieval, processing, and bookkeeping within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main execution method to process email imports from the next available inbound email account.

methods.name: importFromInboundEmailAccount
methods.description: Handles importing emails from a specific inbound email account, including connecting to mail server and processing each mailbox.

methods.name: importFromMailbox
methods.description: Processes emails from a specific mailbox within an inbound email account, including connecting, fetching new messages, and processing each message.

methods.name: importMessage
methods.description: Imports a single message, handling folder-based or individual import depending on configuration.

methods.name: getMessagesToImport
methods.description: Determines which messages need to be imported based on last import time and configurations.

methods.name: getUnimportedMessagesForDate
methods.description: Retrieves messages that have not been imported yet for a specific date.

methods.name: getUnimportedMessages
methods.description: Fetches the list of message UIDs that haven't been imported into the system yet.

methods.name: deleteMessagesFromServer
methods.description: Deletes messages from the mail server after successful import, depending on configuration.

methods.name: loadFolder
methods.description: Loads or retrieves the associated SugarFolder for imported emails.

methods.name: runFolderImport
methods.description: Handles importing an email into a specific folder and updating import records.

methods.name: runIndividualImport
methods.description: Handles individual email import, creating email beans and processing headers.

methods.name: handleCaseCreate
methods.description: Creates a case in SuiteCRM from a specific email if configured for case creation.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Utility method for logging messages with specified severity and section.

methods.name: getNextInboundEmailAccountToImport
methods.description: Retrieves the next inbound email account scheduled for import.

methods.name: updateInboundEmailAccountImportTime
methods.description: Updates the last import run timestamp for an inbound email account.

methods.name: getImapHandler
methods.description: Gets an IMAP handler instance for an inbound email account.

methods.name: connectToMailServer
methods.description: Establishes connection to the email server for an inbound email account.

methods.name: getNewMessages
methods.description: Retrieves new messages from a mailbox for import, depending on protocol.

methods.name: getDBManager
methods.description: Returns a database manager instance, handles connection errors.

methods.name: getUnreadOnlyConfig
methods.description: Checks whether only unread emails should be fetched based on config.

methods.name: getMessageLimitConfig
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of messages to process per run.

methods.name: getImportTimeframeStartConfig
methods.description: Fetches the start date for importing emails based on configuration.

methods.name: getLastImportedDay
methods.description: Gets the last import date for a mailbox to limit re-import of old emails.

methods.name: setLastImportedDay
methods.description: Updates the record of the last import date for a mailbox.
